tt1854564.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
tt1854564.studio: TSG Entertainment, RatPac-Dune Entertainment, 1492 Pictures, 20th Century Studios
tt1854564.description: In order to restore their dying safe haven, the son of Poseidon and his friends embark on a quest to the Sea of Monsters, to find the mythical Golden Fleece, all the while trying to stop an ancient evil from rising.
